reviews.text: I brought my Pomeranian here while I was traveling and everything was top notch. The staff was super helpful and would give me all the details and they also sent me pics. My dog was treated like a princess and she made friends with the other dogs there. I could rest easy bc I know the staff treated my dog as their own. Highly recommend!
My dog came back looking fabulous and smelling amazing! 😂🐶 Great service, thank you for taking such good care of my little friend. …

I have been taking my Cattle Dog and my German Shepherd to Fon Jon since 2016 and they are absolutely the Best! The Cattle Dog did scent training there and she loved it! German Shepherd (adopted from Phoenix shelter 5 years ago) did all of her obedience training with the amazing Team. Both dogs went to daycare for several years and while my Cattle Dog as passed my Sheperd stays with the team every time we travel (between 3 and 21 days). Both dogs receive(d)  their grooming there as well. I broke my arm a couple years ago and they had to stay a month!  The reason for all of this detail is to share with you my vast experience with the Team and why I am qualified to say that I would not trust anyone else with their care, thank you all, we love being part of your Fon Jon Family!

We had such an amazing experience with the staff at Fon Jon when boarding my sensitive, 1.5 year old kitty.
My neighbor recommended Fon Jon to me when I shared that he came home traumatized from his last boarding experience. She has been taking her pets for years.
The lady on the phone sent me a link to fill out plus let me know what information they needed. So easy to complete. Plus, their prices are very reasonable.
When I brought my cat in, Anthony was patient, caring and explained the process. He showed me the cat area so I could select either the single story or two story condo with built in catio! They let me bring his cordless water fountain and food. Claire took such good care of him that my cat came home calm and relaxed!
We highly recommend Fon Jon!!

We worked with Ricky for our Rottweiler puppy and his training sessions made a huge difference in our pups leash behavior and overall self control. We would definitely work with Fon Jon again in the future for both of our dogs!

We've had a range of experience with dog trainers over time with mixed success.  But Fon Jon's is an exception.  We've had both individual and group lessons and the trainers have been uniformly knowledgeable, experienced and clear in their training (of both the dogs and their humans). We have a particularly active and curious Irish-Golden who is very smart but not particularly concerned with civility or following commands, that he knows well.  A Fon Jon's intermediate class has helped enormously toward getting him to follow direction consistently (not just when he feels like it), Training is not magic but he and i have made a big jump thanks to our work with Fon JOn.
Ollie loves coming to don jon and working with fon and Ricky.  He has learned  so much and same with my self we will definitely  be using your services again

We had a great experience with Fon’s Canines two-week board and train program for our dogs. One of the trainers, Laurie, kept us updated with pictures, videos, and progress reports, which gave us peace of mind knowing our pups were doing well.
We especially appreciated that the first day focused on fun and bonding with Ricky, the trainer, to help build trust before the official training began. Even though the program was structured, our dogs were treated with great care. One of our dogs has severe hip dysplasia, and the trainers were very mindful of her limitations and adjusted accordingly.
The results have been amazing — our dogs no longer pull, and walks are so much more enjoyable. The trainer also took time to thoroughly explain the techniques to us.  We have already used two hours of the four follow-up hour sessions included with the program, with Ricky, in our home, and it was incredibly helpful. We look forward to the remaining sessions.
Overall, very friendly staff, great communication, and it’s clear they truly care about the dogs in their care. Highly recommend Fon Jon’s!

I left my goldendoodle for the weekend last week and I was pleased with how I received him. He was happy, calm, and tired; from all the fun he was having with the other dogs that were there that weekend. Throughout the weekend, I received photos and updates on how my dog was doing which gave me a peace of mind. I will be bringing my dog back very soon!

March 2026 update: finally rolled out an online reservation system!!

---

I moved to San Diego 1 year ago and have been working with Fon Jon since then everytime we need to board my two dogs.  I have two boxer mixes, about 70lbs each that are high energy.  One is dog and human friendly, while the other requires a proper introduction in order to get along with humans and dogs.  I am always apprehensive when I bring them to a new boarding place/daycare, but both of them have had no issues staying at Fon Jon to my knowledge and always come home bright, alert and responsive.  That said, here's my additional feedback.

Pros:
- Several boarding/daycare options (I like that there was the option to board with other dogs or separately and on top of separately they can board together or alone)
- Average cost for a boarding facility like this
- Plenty of staff always available, I often see the same faces working with my dogs and it seems like they look forward to seeing those faces when we pull up in the parking lot
- Free day of day care when you first sign up in lieu of a meet and greet style test

Cons:
- Big con overall is anything to do with paperwork.  You might think it is 2002 not 2022 lol... There are no online forms integrated into the website to schedule a stay.  Instead they email a document to be submitted each stay.  🚨DO NOT🚨 submit this in person ahead of time, because it will go into a folder and get lost by the time you're about to go out of town and come for drop off
- Along similar lines, there is no option to upload vaccine records to a portal or create an account/pet profile.  Again email it, don't bring a hard copy, because it'll get lost
- No live video feeds and you don't get any photos

If you care about the cons (I can understand, because they are really REALLY ANNOYING), skip this place.

However, for the past year I have continued to use Fon Jon because they are reliable, you know what to expect working with them, and it seems like the staff can handle my dogs well--ultimately those things are more important to me.
Very kind people that have made me feel super reassured about leaving my doggies here for a long stay! so excited to have a boarding/daycare facility so nearby :)

We had an amazing experience with Fon Jon Pet Care & Boarding and couldn’t be happier with the care our dog received. From the very beginning, the staff was professional, friendly, and clearly passionate about animals. You can tell they genuinely care, not just about doing a job, but about making sure every pet feels safe, comfortable, and loved.

Communication was excellent throughout — we received updates and had peace of mind knowing our dog was in great hands. The facility was clean, well-organized, and set up perfectly for boarding and play. Our dog came home happy, calm, and well taken care of, which says everything.

If you’re looking for a trustworthy, reliable, and caring place for pet boarding or care, Fon Jon is absolutely the place to go. We’ll definitely be returning and highly recommend them to anyone looking for quality pet care
Great experience, great staff, happy dog! Will definitely come back in the future!

Absolutely love Fon Jon Pet Care. The team truly cares, and it shows in the way they pay attention to every little detail. I always get updates, which gives me so much peace of mind. And honestly, it feels less like dropping my pet off at a facility and more like leaving them with a trusted friend. The warmth, the kindness, the welcome, everything is just unmatched.

My dog has been going to Fon Jon since we rescued her as a puppy. Many years. When we pick her up she looks healthy, and happy. They take great care of her! While our dog is always happy to see us pick her up, we know she is also happy there and that gives us peace of mind when we are on vacation.  This summer, we took a three week vacation and our dog did great! When we picked her up, she was clean and her nails were trimmed! Happy dog!  When we drop my pooch off, she happily runs in with the staff. Fon Jon Petcare is The Best and I highly recommend!
We love Fon Jon! The employees are so friendly and helpful and the team takes great care of our dog.

Best customer service in town. The staff at Fon Jon clearly love the pets. We have taken our dog there many times and could not be any happier. The service is outstanding and when we show up with our dog, she runs right in. We also like that they have different kennels available, depending on the needs of your dog.  The dogs get plenty of playtime and a huge area to run around and play.
We like the location because they are on a road that is away from busy streets and neighborhoods
We’ve also used their dog trainers and was very very happy with that as well. Our dog responds to both verbal and hand signals extremely well.

Amazing staff who really care about our dogs. Top quality training facility in Socal also. Perfect combination for a train and stay Petcation! You lay on the week while your dog is trained and looked after.
I love Fon Jon petcare! They have taken care of my pups while I was out of town and won’t trust anyone else. You can tell the staff really loves dogs and they love their jobs.
Great staff and very helpful! Well knowledged
Mocha Joy loves it! She gets home really tired whenever she comes here!! Staff is extremely friendly and professional! Thanks a lot for taking great of our baby!
Fon Jon is the best!  The staff is truly delightful, the services are a great value and my pup Charlotte loves to see her buddies at day care! Always beyond excited to come play!  Highly recommend!

There is no where in the world who will love and take better care of your pups. Every one of the staff members are warm, kind, professional and helpful. It is home away from home for both is our dogs and I thank God they exist! Can’t say enough good things.
They are so wonderful! I am grateful they have been taking such good care of my puppy. They make sure they are safe and happy and even helped when he wasn't eating well.
Highly recommend

Fon Jon is the best! We were extremely nervous as first time puppy parents and every employee at Fon Jon helped ease our concerns. I have not met an employee there who was not kind and who didn’t seem excited to be there. Our puppy Willow absolutely loves Fon Jon and we love how tired she is when she gets home! This was our dog Willow on her very first day at daycare. I think it speaks for itself! Thank you to the amazing staff.

The only ones I trust for dog training! Our German Shepherd needed a lot of direction that we didn’t know how to give. Ricky is an awesome trainer and made a huge difference with our dog. The whole team is great and will also work with you financially.
My dogs love the staff, and get great care.

My dog, Jaxon loves his day out with his canine buddies at Fon Jon! Dogs have been evaluated so you know they are going to play nice! The humans are also great! Minah or Anthony greet you with a smile and George is busy rounding up the pups to come or go!

I just started using Fon Jon’s a couple months ago to board my two cats, Channing who is 10 years old, and Charlotte who is 9. I have used several cat boarding facilities over the years and Fon Jon’s by far has the most trustworthy, kind, and caring staff I have encountered. The cat condos are clean, spacious, and safe; to keep any crafty guests from escaping. You can tell the entire staff adores animals! Anthony and Minah went above and beyond, even hand feeding, cuddling and spoiling my babies and promptly replying to my check-in texts. As long as we are in San Diego I will never trust any other place to care for my kitties when we are away from home. Five stars isn’t enough! Thank you Fon Jon’s😁😻😻

All the staff at Fon Jon were able to bond with our rescue that has challenges with new people and places. We didn’t think it was possible for our dog to grow trust in others, but the kind and patient staff made the seemingly impossible possible.

Fon Jon Pet Care is a great place to take your dog for training, and Ricky is a great trainer! He really seems to care about the dogs, and knows what will work best with each specific dog. The office was very good about sending weekly reminders for our training sessions, and very informative when I called. I will be using their boarding services very soon as well!
I cannot tell you how wonderfully accommodating these people are and how good they are with my dog!
Anthony and Mina are the best!

I originally found out about Fon Jon through their Man K9 facility. Her first trainer said she was borderline untrainable (she’s a puppy with selective hearing) and she learned more with Fon in an hour session than she had in weeks of training. When I got a new job and needed to take her to daycare Fon Jon was the obvious choice, they recommend you tour the facility and do a lot to accommodate schedules, pet needs, etc. It’s one of those businesses that you can tell actually enjoys what they do. It’s a huge relief to know anytime I need to go out of town for a few days or if something pops up on my schedule, I can drop her over there and she’ll have a ton of fun and be well looked after.
The best dog daycare in San Diego. Very attentive to you and your dog! Also the grooming services are the best in town. Even if you live far, the drive is always worth it

We have boarded our cat, Olive, with Fon Jon’s twice now. Both times have been an absolutely fantastic experience ! Minah and Anthony always go above and beyond.
Olive gets a little stressed for the first few days then settles, and Minah has been amazing with her! Going as far to sitting with her at lunchtime (Olive loves company while she dines!) and providing other options at meal time.
Minah communicates with us very quickly regarding care, any questions we may have or to provide updates on Olive’s stay! You can tell her, and the whole staff absolutely love animals + show great care and attention to each in their care.
I cannot recommend Fon Jon Pet Care enough!

They are extremely unreliable and incredibly rude. After having told them multiple times of an early drop off, their employee gave us a hard time and also told me that they will refuse service. Imagine making arrangements weeks in advance …

Office staff is incompetent and rude. Gave them my drop off time multiple times. Then they were surprised, giving me an attitude, because I was there for an early drop off. They also needed to be reminded of the feeding schedule three …

We truly value your trust and thank you for taking the time to leave us a review.

Wonderful and organized.

Fon Jon's Pet Care and K9 Training is an absolute dream! Being a new dog mom was initially overwhelming, but discovering Fon Jon's changed everything. Dropping off Frank is completely stress-free (even for a helicopter mom like me lol) …
